changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `770cc5ba4` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1897 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2510 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36826108812)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7b70a05236de84d1c3d98b4c3c28a5a7c48a7f47`
Local-runs: none

Read: card objectui#11331 (body, claim `5925206749`, dev report `5925493931`), PR objectui#11338 (body, its 3-file list, the net diff against `main` `5262f7dd3f`, which is the merge-base: +317/−0, one commit), the head's 43 check-runs, and read-only objectui#11293's patch round 2 report (`5925143481`) and PR objectui#11296 (objectui#11272). Nothing was built, run or re-run; git reads and REST GETs only. Line numbers below are the head's, all "about".

### ① Derived judgments

**Public surface and accept sets: none move.** The diff adds no export, prop, type, registry entry or spec key. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` gains 32 lines, all inside the bodies of three existing `useEffect`s; the other two files are a new pin and a changeset. Right.

**(a) The rule as implemented.** The three draft-load effects (`InterfacesPillar` `:2237`, `DataPillar` `:3341`, `AutomationsPillar` `:4504`) each keep a local `settled`, set it as the first statement of `finally`, and their cleanup does `cancelled = true; if (!settled) setLoading(false)`. Right, and it holds:
- It clears exactly what a cancelled run raised, and never a later run's flag. The cleanup closes over its own run's `settled`; React runs a run's cleanup before the next run's setup, so the lower is enqueued before any later raise and no later run exists at cleanup time. In each pillar `loading` has no writer outside its draft-load effect (`:2031/:2253/:2283/:2296`, `:3190/:3354/:3386/:3399`, `:4397/:4509/:4531/:4540`).
- `settled` is true at cleanup time only if `finally` already ran, and it ran with `cancelled` false (the cleanup is the only writer of `cancelled`), so `finally` had already lowered `loading`. For `loading` the guard is an idempotence guard at all three sites; it is load-bearing for the Data claim in (b).
- StrictMode's double effect: setup, cleanup (unsettled, so lower), setup (raise), batched in one flush. The first load's `finally` sees `cancelled` and lowers nothing; the second load's lowers. In Data the cleanup also nulls the claim, so the second setup loads instead of bailing; at the base the second setup would have bailed on a load the first cleanup cancelled.
- A reload of the same leaf (`publishNonce` or `client` in the deps): the cleanup lowers if unsettled and the re-run raises in the same flush. In Data the key carries the nonce, so a publish is a new key either way.
- Error path: `catch` sets the error only `if (!cancelled)`; `finally` sets `settled` and lowers only `if (!cancelled)`. A cancelled run's error never lands and its `loading` is lowered by the cleanup; a settled error already lowered it. The canvas's `error && !loading ? null` rule (`:2520`, `:3878`, `:4760`) is unchanged.
- Unmount (the pillars are keyed by `packageId`): the cleanup's `setLoading(false)` on an unmounting component is a no-op.

**(b) The Data site's extra release.** Under the same `!settled` guard the Data cleanup also does `loadedNameRef.current = null` (`:3400`). The ref has no other writer (`:3350` the claim, `:3400` the release). One rule, not a per-site variant: the shape is the same at the three sites, and the Data run's start makes two claims, `loading` and the load-once key (`:3349`–`:3354`); "a cancelled run takes back what its start claimed" lists both. The card's own Data row names the bail on the same key as that site's early return, and the Data spinner is the `!objLoaded` arm (`:3875`; Data reads `loading` only inside that arm's error rule, `:3878`), so neither of the card's two example shapes makes the Data row green without the release; the dev measured that (D1 red). Right. It does not reopen objectui#11272's guarantee: a settled load keeps its claim, so a client change after the load bails as before (`:3349`); inside the unsettled window the open item has no buffer of its own to clobber (`objLoaded` is `loadedFor === target`, false until this load installs `objDraftFor` at `:3370`; `sending` claims nothing; the cancelled run installs nothing past `if (cancelled) return` at `:3364`). The D3 pin is sound: the guard row proves the new client reached the pillar (its rail `list` call), then asserts exactly one `layered` read of the object; an unconditional release turns it red with two reads.

**(c) Automations.** The source reading is true at this head. `current`'s writers in `AutomationsPillar` are three: the list effect's `c ?? deepLinked ?? items[0] ?? null` (`:4462`, which keeps a non-null `c`), the create (`:4490`, the new item) and the rail click (`:4716`, `f`); there is no `setCurrent(null)` and `setCurrent` is handed to no child. The draft-load effect's only early return is `!current` (`:4505`) and it has no load-once guard, so every re-run with a flow open loads: a cancelled flow load always has a replacement within one mount, and a package switch unmounts the pillar. The canvas's `!current` branch (`:4755`) precedes `loading || !flowLoaded` (`:4757`), so no spinner shows with no flow. The written reason the card allows in place of a row stands. Applying the same cleanup there anyway is right: it is the family rule, and the replacement run re-raises in the same flush. The cost is a limit, not a defect: the site is unpinned, so a future writer that nulls `current` mid-load would be covered by the rule and not by a row.

**(d) No second spinner.** True. The cleanup's lower and the replacement run's raise both run in the passive-effects phase of one commit and batch into one render. Independently of that, the arms hold the spinner for a new item until its own load installs: Interfaces `loading || !draftLoaded` (`:2516`, `draftFor` stamped on install at `:2276`), Data `!objLoaded` (`:3875`, `objDraftFor` at `:3370`), Automations `loading || !flowLoaded` (`:4757`, `draftFor` at `:4524`). A leaf with no designer takes the early branch, which stamps `draftFor` to itself (`:2245`), so with `loading` lowered the canvas falls through to its own state, which is what the symptom file waits for.

**(e) Pins** (`StudioDesignSurface.cancelledLoad-11331.test.tsx`: 5 rows, gated `layered` reads, the real pillars under `canvasFrame.test.tsx`'s mocks). The red-first mechanism matches the base source: the Interfaces race row waits for the no-designer text under the report caption, which the stuck `loading || !draftLoaded` arm never shows; the Data race row waits for add-field, which the bail leaves behind `!objLoaded`. The dev's 2 failed / 3 passed at `5262f7dd3f`, 5/5 plus `canvasFrame` 2/2 after, 10/10 repeats and legs I, D1 and D3 are consistent with that reading; the head's eight test shards, all green with shard 2/8 among them (the shard the race kept red on objectui#11323), are the gate verdict. The plausible wrong fix: clearing `loading` only in the Interfaces early-return branch is one of the card's two allowed shapes, and the Interfaces rows cannot tell it from the cleanup, which is right; the same branch-only shape in Data leaves `!objLoaded` standing and the Data race row red, so a family-wide branch-only fix fails the pin. Not caught, named as limits: a Data cleanup that releases the claim but omits `setLoading(false)` (the flag is unobservable there outside the error rule), and anything at the Automations site. The control row's 4000 ms wait for the dashboard grid is the same wait `canvasFrame.test.tsx` uses for its own grid (`:110`). `canvasFrame.test.tsx` is unchanged, and the diff holds no `heavyDomTests` entry.

**Canvas branch order and objectui#11272's stamping:** unchanged. The diff is additions only; it touches no `draftFor`, `ifDirty`, `hasDraft` or `objDraftFor` write and no arm.

**(g) Check-runs on the head:** 43, all completed, none in progress: 39 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)`, `dependabot`), 1 failure. The failure is `Spec Main Shape Gate` (job `110235909441`): objectui#11330, objectstack `d830d71f`'s branded retired-key types, failing in `packages/types` pins and `packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx`, none of which this diff touches (the seat's `5925588822` on the PR); its fix is PR objectui#11343, landing now. Named, not counted against this PR. Every other gate is green on its own conclusion: `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Test (shard 1/8)` through `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Bundle Analysis` (console eager closure 3585.7 KB of a 3607.4 KB budget, PASS).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11331-app-shell-cancelled-load-spinner.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. Right: a bug fix in component-internal state; no export, prop, type or accept set moves, and the one released package touched is the one declared (`Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Bump Policy` green). `Clause-②: no` is right for the same reason. The text is true: each pillar raised `loading` at the start and lowered it only in `finally` behind `if (!cancelled)` (the base source, all three sites); the Interfaces bullet is the measured race; the Data bullet names its own cause (the re-run skipped the load, the cancelled load installed nothing); the closing paragraph states the rule, the Data claim and the settled-claim guarantee as the head's source has them. One nuance, not a falsehood: the lead sentence attributes the family's spinner to `loading`, while in Data the visible arm is `!objLoaded`; the Data bullet carries the accurate cause. The pending `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md` that `Changeset Claim Re-read` named stays true: this diff moves no import of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1, the Data claim release: answered in ① (b). One rule, declared where the card asked, measured both ways (D1 red without it, D3 red when over-applied). Not a per-site variant.
- Dev deviation 2, lint narrowed to the two changed files: answered by the head's `Lint` check-run, green.
- PR acceptance note, the Data site's reach: the pin reaches it through a `useMetadataClient` re-mint, and no console flow that re-mints the client mid-load was exercised. Accepted as a declared limit: the card listed the Data site as read at source and not measured, and the pin now measures it through the component.
- `open_questions`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: none.
- Reviewer's own: the Automations site is unpinned on a source reading that is true at this head (① (c)); the card allows the written reason. Not escalated.
- The card's ⛔ lines: no timeout raise in `canvasFrame.test.tsx` (unchanged), no `heavyDomTests` entry, canvas branch order unchanged, objectui#11272's stamping untouched. All held. The PR is still a draft; readiness is the seat's.
